name: Myrtos Beach
type: bay; recreation area; beach; tourist destination
text: Myrtos Beach (Greek: Παραλία Μύρτου [Míːrtɒs]) is in the region of Pylaros, in the north-west of Kefalonia island, in the Ionian Sea of Greece. Myrtos beach lies between the feet of two mountains, Agia Dynati and Kalon Oros (901m).

depictions.name: Myrtos Beach
depictions.text: Myrtos Beach is a beach that was located in northeastern Cursed Valley of Pali in Kephallonia, Greece.
